critical_code_review_comments: funnel._record builds reasons with only a single string (stage-1 reason). For PASS/CONTRA_4H/BAJA_CONFIANZA the deep-model reasoning is stored in ai_reasoning (shown as paragraph in the card) but is NOT added to the reasons[] chip list, so the visible chips are 'Filtro rápido: …' only. Not a bug (reasoning is still visible), but consider adding 'Modelo potente (N%): …' to reasons for consistency with the APROBADA/BAJA_CONFIANZA execution path which does include both.
AiSignals.jsx line 53: SL/TP are suppressed when `s.sl` is falsy (0). Fine for the current fix. Keep in mind that any future non-zero-but-very-small SL would still render; current spec is OK.

_record() passes side = BUY/SELL verdict side even in the CONTRA_4H case (res.decision BUY→long, SELL→short). The side stored matches the AI's wish, not the allowed bias. The UI relies on this, but worth documenting.
